prompt: A text field and an Add button share one ActionListener -- pressing Enter in the field fires an ActionEvent too. Complete actionPerformed so both routes add a trimmed, non-empty task.
explanation: JTextField is an ActionEvent source in its own right: pressing Enter in it fires the same kind of event a button does, so a single listener handles both input routes and there is no duplicated logic. Because the handler always reads the current field text rather than anything carried on the event, it does not care which component fired. trim() plus an isEmpty() guard rejects blank input before anything is stored.
hints: You do not need e.getSource() here -- both routes want the same thing, so just read entry.getText().
String.trim() removes surrounding spaces; test the trimmed value with isEmpty() and return early when it is blank.
After storing the task, entry.setText("") clears the field and tasks.size() gives the number for the label.
